units.source_text: 父亲一周年忌辰到来了。

en.t: The first anniversary of my father's death arrived.

units.source_text: 母亲没想了一个难以想像的方案。

en.t: My mother came up with an almost unimaginable plan.

units.source_text: 正逢义务劳动总动员，我不能返回故里，

en.t: It happened to coincide with the general mobilization for compulsory labor, so I could not return to my hometown,

units.source_text: 母亲就打算亲自将父亲的牌位送来京都，

en.t: and my mother planned to bring my father's memorial tablet to Kyoto herself,

units.source_text: 请求田山道诠和尚为旧友忌辰诵经，

en.t: and ask the priest Tayama Dosen to chant sutras on the anniversary of his old friend's death,
even if it was only for a few minutes.

units.source_text: 她压根儿没钱，只好求他看在清分上。

en.t: She had no money at all, so she could only appeal to him on the strength of their old friendship.

units.source_text: 于是她给和尚发了一封信。

en.t: So she sent the priest a letter.

units.source_text: 和尚答应了，并且把这个意思告诉了我。

en.t: The priest agreed, and told me of his decision.
